overall_status: Prior content audit retained; author-confirmed identifying-information access statement inserted and official checklist completed.

checks_passed.evidence: Actual DOCX title 95 characters, short title 55, abstract 251 whitespace-separated words and no numeric citations; objective, design, results, main interpretation present.

Ziyuan Zhu, College of Artificial Intelligence Medicine, Chongqing Medical University, Chongqing, China; corresponding email and ORCID present in title page and author worksheet. No placeholder author, email or affiliation fields found.

19 numbered main-manuscript references in first-citation order; original Kumar study and its correction both cited; arXiv source explicitly labeled Preprint; unresolved citeproc markers absent. Prior bibliography metadata verification reused.

Submission and reading DOCX textual contents were identical after exclusion of empty image paragraphs. Source copies match working source versions. Six figures and six tables are first cited in 1-6 order. S1/S2 numerical checkpoints use matching cohorts, units, label budgets and equal participant/session weighting.

Source version and DOI, chronological source/support/query allocation, preprocessing, CSP/LDA settings, neural configuration and seed/validation budgets, independent participant unit, bootstrap resampling, exploratory sign-flip hierarchy, post hoc analysis designation, inclusion and missing class rules, and executable saved-result reproduction are given.

7.42-point total gain, 5.47-point matched-label contrast and 73.7% ratio of cohort means consistently defined. Correction 16.04 minus introduced error 10.57 reconstructs the component gain. Class-recall increases are qualified as mean changes, with their intervals crossing zero retained. Development, full cohort, exploratory multiplicity-adjusted tests and participant/session variation remain reported.

Versioned public NEMAR source and DOI; public repository, source and ethics tags, current extension path; portable S1 Data with predictions, underlying figure data and scripts. No statement that data are only available from the author on request.

Dedicated Methods section names OpenAI ChatGPT/Codex, lists software/analysis/figure/source-check/writing/export uses, and describes output validation. Figure legends and S2 also disclose figure/analysis assistance. No external AI-detector score or guarantee is claimed.

Financial disclosure is absent from the main manuscript and recorded in the author worksheet; eight named CRediT roles provided. Competing interests retained in system worksheet after main-file removal.

Original University of Texas at Austin protocol 2020-03-0073 and written consent separately identified. Author-reported Chongqing Medical University exemption confirmation dated 16 October 2026, Article 32(1), explicitly no reference number. It is not presented as a newly issued prior IRB approval or as a consent waiver.
No TODO/TBD/FIXME/XXX/PLACEHOLDER or unresolved citation markers in inspected DOCX files; no tracked insertions/deletions or comment references.

Prior saved-result validation is reused; no claim is made to new model training, independent external validation, original institutional-document authentication or author confirmation of facts not supplied.
